attributes.description: Game processes started, by game. One launch can start several, such as a launcher and a crash reporter.

query.esql:
FROM logs-steam.gameprocess-*
| WHERE event.action == "tracked-process-start"
| LOOKUP JOIN steam_lookup.app_name ON steam.app.id
| EVAL application = COALESCE(steam.app.name, steam.app.id)
| STATS processes = COUNT(*) BY timestamp = BUCKET(@timestamp, 50, ?_tstart, ?_tend), application

attributes.description: Executables Steam tracked for each game, and how often each started.

query.esql:
FROM logs-steam.gameprocess-*
| WHERE event.action == "tracked-process-start"
| LOOKUP JOIN steam_lookup.app_name ON steam.app.id
| EVAL application = COALESCE(steam.app.name, steam.app.id)
| STATS started = COUNT(*), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp) BY executable = process.name, application
| SORT started DESC
| LIMIT 20

FROM logs-steam.gameprocess-*

attributes.description: Non-zero exits by game and exit code. Exit lines do not record the executable.

query.esql:
FROM logs-steam.gameprocess-*
| WHERE event.action == "tracked-process-end" AND process.exit_code != 0
| LOOKUP JOIN steam_lookup.app_name ON steam.app.id
| EVAL application = COALESCE(steam.app.name, steam.app.id)
| STATS exits = COUNT(*), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp) BY application, exit_code = TO_STRING(process.exit_code)
| SORT exits DESC
| LIMIT 20

| STATS updates = COUNT(*) BY application
| SORT updates DESC
| LIMIT 10
